comment.body:
Thanks for the screenshot and for identifying PowerToys 0.98.1 installed through auto-update. The report says Run at startup is unchecked after returning to Settings, but it does not establish whether this still happens on a current build or whether the task was registered. Please confirm:
1. The exact current PowerToys version.
2. Whether this is a per-user or per-machine install and whether the checkbox is checked immediately before closing Settings.
3. Whether it becomes unchecked only after reopening.
If you can reproduce this on current stable, comment /bugreport immediately after the attempt so maintainers can inspect current startup state.
